traits.note: The legume family's description in Watson and Dallwitz's DELTA, on its Hamburg mirror, as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): in the subfamily Papilionoideae, to which Cytisus belongs, a papilionaceous corolla of five petals (a standard or banner, two wings, and the two lowest petals joined as the keel), five sepals, usually 10 stamens (fused in one tube in Cytisus), one carpel and a superior ovary. The Flora of New Zealand (vol. IV, Webb and others 1988) on Cytisus scoparius, as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): corolla golden yellow, 16 to 25 mm long; stamens 10, joined in a tube.
